## Custom methods whose caller's standing is not graded

A custom method with no `gate:` in `methods:` takes the model's read gate as a
FLOOR, and a floor checks only that a caller is signed in (`FJS-826`). A method
that writes through `asSystem()` from here is open to every caller who can sign
in, whatever the row policies say, because the Data boundary never sees who
asked. Each row below is either meant — a read-shaped method, a scoped write —
or wants `methods: [{ method, gate }]`.

  - `buildPlan` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `openPlan` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `closePlan` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `go` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `next` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `tick` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `file` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `decide` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `fork` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `freeze` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `thaw` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `land` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `commit` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `archive` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `run` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `halt` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`

| Phase | Method | Chain |
| --- | --- | --- |
| around | `all` | `gateAuth` |
| before | `all` | `sessionScope` |
| before | `find` | `autoFilter` → `autoSort` |
| before | `get` | `autoFilter` |
| before | `aggregate` | `autoFilter` |
| before | `create` | `autoValidate` |
| before | `patch` | `autoValidate` |
| before | `update` | `autoValidate` |

### `workspaces` · model `Workspace`

- **methods** — `find`, `get`, `create`, `patch`, `remove`, `restore`, `members`, `addMember`, `setMemberRole`, `removeMember`, `leave`, `push`, `testPing`
- **custom methods** — `members`, `addMember`, `setMemberRole`, `removeMember`, `leave`, `push`, `testPing`
- **input** — `addMember` takes `WorkspaceMemberAdd`
- **input** — `setMemberRole` takes `WorkspaceMemberRole`
- **who may call** —
  - `restore` — **any signed-in caller** — floor, read gate 1; standing not graded; then `authenticate`
  - `members` — **any signed-in caller** — floor, read gate 1; standing not graded; then `authenticate`
  - `addMember` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `setMemberRole` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `removeMember` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `leave` — **any signed-in caller** — floor, read gate 1; standing not graded; then `authenticate`; body writes as the app
  - `push` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`
  - `testPing` — standing 5 or above — declared `gate: 5`; body writes as the app

| Phase | Method | Chain |
| --- | --- | --- |
| around | `all` | `gateAuth` |
| before | `all` | `authenticate` |
| before | `create` | `stampOwnership` → `autoValidate` |
| before | `addMember` | `refuseGrantAboveOwn` → `validateInput` |
| before | `setMemberRole` | `refuseGrantAboveOwn` → `validateInput` |
| before | `find` | `autoFilter` → `autoSort` |
| before | `get` | `autoFilter` |
| before | `aggregate` | `autoFilter` |
| before | `patch` | `autoValidate` |
| before | `update` | `autoValidate` |

## Routes

Read off the router, so a path appears here whether or not anything meant to
mount it. A `{service}` path is the CRUD handler and names every service at
once; everything else was registered by hand or by a plugin.

| Method | Path | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/` | raw |
| DELETE | `/{service}` | service |
| GET | `/{service}` | service |
| PATCH | `/{service}` | service |
| POST | `/{service}` | service |
| PUT | `/{service}` | service |
| DELETE | `/{service}/{id}` | service |
| GET | `/{service}/{id}` | service |
| PATCH | `/{service}/{id}` | service |
| POST | `/{service}/{id}` | service |
| PUT | `/{service}/{id}` | service |
| OPTIONS | `/*` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/email/verify` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/email/verify/request` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/login` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/login/challenge` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | raw |
| GET | `/auth/oauth` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/password-reset/confirm` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/password-reset/request` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/register` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/support/end` | raw |
| POST | `/auth/support/start` | raw |
| GET | `/auth/workspace` | raw |
| GET | `/backup-archive/{id}` | raw |
| GET | `/health` | raw |
| GET | `/health/live` | raw |
| GET | `/health/ready` | raw |
| POST | `/hooks/git/{appId}` | raw |

| GET | `/install.sh` | raw |

| GET | `/metrics` | raw |
| POST | `/orion/hooks/{path}` | raw |
